THE STORY

THE TOURNAMENT IS ONLY THE BEGINNING.

Fight of Your Life is an original action story built around ten strangers chosen to compete in a high-stakes fighting tournament for one million dollars.

What begins as a new form of online entertainment quickly becomes something much larger. Every fighter enters for a different reason. Every fight changes the story.
